passages.text: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: ‘Who can be compared to your greatness?
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
This happened in the eleventh year.
It was the first day of the third month.
The LORD gave me a message.
He said, “Son of man, speak to Pharaoh.
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
Speak also to all his people.
Ask them this question.
Who can be compared to your greatness?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בַּשְּׁלִישִׁ֖י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶל־ הֲמוֹנ֑וֹ אֶל־ מִ֖י דָּמִ֥יתָ בְגָדְלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Look at Assyria, a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches that shaded the forest. It towered on high; its top was among the clouds.
passages.sermon:
Assyria was a powerful nation.
Assyria was like a cedar tree in Lebanon.
This cedar had beautiful branches.
Its branches gave shade to the forest.
The cedar tree was very tall.
Its top reached high among the thick clouds.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אַשּׁ֜וּר אֶ֣רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֗וֹן יְפֵ֥ה עָנָ֛ף וְחֹ֥רֶשׁ מֵצַ֖ל וּגְבַ֣הּ קוֹמָ֑ה וּבֵ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים הָיְתָ֖ה צַמַּרְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The waters made it grow; the deep springs made it tall, directing their streams all around its base and sending their channels to all the trees of the field.
passages.sermon:
Assyria was like a cedar tree in Lebanon.
The waters made this tree grow.
The deep springs made it tall.
The rivers flowed around the tree’s base.
The streams reached out to all the trees in the field.
passages.original: מַ֣יִם גִּדְּל֔וּהוּ תְּה֖וֹם רֹֽמְמָ֑תְהוּ אֶת־ נַהֲרֹתֶ֗יהָ הֹלֵךְ֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת מַטָּעָ֔הּ וְאֶת־ תְּעָלֹתֶ֣יהָ שִׁלְחָ֔ה אֶ֖ל כָּל־ עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore it towered higher than all the trees of the field. Its branches multiplied, and its boughs grew long as it spread them out because of the abundant waters.
passages.sermon:
Assyria was like a cedar tree in Lebanon.
This tree stood taller than all the other trees in the field.
Its branches became many.
Its boughs grew long.
The tree spread its boughs wide.
Abundant waters made its boughs grow and spread.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ גָּבְהָ֣א קֹמָת֔וֹ מִכֹּ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וַתִּרְבֶּ֨ינָה סַֽרְעַפֹּתָ֜יו וַתֶּאֱרַ֧כְנָה פֹארָתוֹ מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים בְּשַׁלְּחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: All the birds of the air nested in its branches, and all the beasts of the field gave birth beneath its boughs; all the great nations lived in its shade.
passages.sermon:
This tree was very great and beautiful.
All the birds of the sky made their nests in its branches.
All the wild animals gave birth under its boughs.
Many nations lived in its shade.
passages.original: בִּסְעַפֹּתָ֤יו קִֽנְנוּ֙ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְתַ֤חַת פֹּֽארֹתָיו֙ יָֽלְד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּבְצִלּוֹ֙ יֵֽשְׁב֔וּ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: It was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its limbs, for its roots extended to abundant waters.
passages.sermon:
This tree was very great.
It was beautiful.
Its limbs were long.
Its roots reached to abundant waters.
passages.original: וַיְּיִ֣ף בְּגָדְל֔וֹ בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ דָּֽלִיּוֹתָ֑יו כִּֽי־ הָיָ֥ה שָׁרְשׁ֖וֹ אֶל־ מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it; the cypresses could not compare with its branches, nor the plane trees match its boughs. No tree in the garden of God could compare with its beauty.
passages.sermon:
The subject is a great and beautiful tree in the garden of God.
The cedars in the garden of God could not rival this tree.
The cypresses could not compare with its branches.
The plane trees could not match its boughs.
No tree in the garden of God could compare with its beauty.
passages.original: אֲרָזִ֣ים לֹֽא־ עֲמָמֻהוּ֮ בְּגַן־ אֱלֹהִים֒ בְּרוֹשִׁ֗ים לֹ֤א דָמוּ֙ אֶל־ סְעַפֹּתָ֔יו וְעַרְמֹנִ֥ים לֹֽא־ הָי֖וּ כְּפֹֽארֹתָ֑יו כָּל־ עֵץ֙ בְּגַן־ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ דָמָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו בְּיָפְיֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I made it beautiful with its many branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden, which were in the garden of God.’
passages.sermon:
God made this tree beautiful.
God gave it many branches.
All the trees of Eden saw it.
These trees were in the garden of God.
All the trees of Eden envied this tree.
passages.original: יָפֶ֣ה עֲשִׂיתִ֔יו בְּרֹ֖ב דָּֽלִיּוֹתָ֑יו וַיְקַנְאֻ֙הוּ֙ כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ עֵ֔דֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּגַ֥ן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Since it became great in height and set its top among the clouds, and it grew proud on account of its height, I delivered it into the hand of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with it according to its wickedness. I have banished it.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses a tree that grew very tall.
This tree set its top among the clouds.
The tree became proud because of its height.
The Lord GOD took action.
He delivered the tree into the hand of the ruler of the nations.
The ruler acted against the tree because of its wickedness.
The Lord GOD banished the tree.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּבַ֖הְתָּ בְּקוֹמָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֤ן צַמַּרְתּוֹ֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ין עֲבוֹתִ֔ים וְרָ֥ם לְבָב֖וֹ בְּגָבְהֽוֹ׃ וְאֶ֨תְּנֵ֔הוּ בְּיַ֖ד אֵ֣יל גּוֹיִ֑ם עָשׂ֤וֹ יַֽעֲשֶׂה֙ ל֔וֹ כְּרִשְׁע֖וֹ גֵּרַשְׁתִּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, cut it down and left it. Its branches have fallen on the mountains and in every valley; its boughs lay broken in all the earth’s ravines. And all the peoples of the earth left its shade and abandoned it.
passages.sermon:
Foreigners came.
These foreigners were the most ruthless of the nations.
They cut it down.
They left it behind.
Its branches fell on the mountains.
Its branches also fell in every valley.
Its boughs lay broken in all the ravines of the earth.
All the peoples of the earth left its shade.
They abandoned it.
passages.original: וַיִּכְרְתֻ֧הוּ זָרִ֛ים עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם וַֽיִּטְּשֻׁ֑הוּ אֶל־ הֶ֠הָרִים וּבְכָל־ גֵּ֨אָי֜וֹת נָפְל֣וּ דָלִיּוֹתָ֗יו וַתִּשָּׁבַ֤רְנָה פֹֽארֹתָיו֙ בְּכֹל֙ אֲפִיקֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֵּרְד֧וּ מִצִּלּ֛וֹ כָּל־ עַמֵּ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ וַֽיִּטְּשֻֽׁהוּ׃

passages.text: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk, and all the beasts of the field lived among its boughs.
passages.sermon: The tree fell.\r\nAll the birds of the sky made their nests on its trunk.\r\nAll the wild animals lived among its branches.
passages.original: עַל־ מַפַּלְתּ֥וֹ יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶל־ פֹּארֹתָ֣יו הָי֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: This happened so that no other trees by the waters would become great in height and set their tops among the clouds, and no other well-watered trees would reach them in height. For they have all been consigned to death, to the depths of the earth, among the mortals who descend to the Pit.’
passages.sermon:
God acted for a reason.
He did this so that no other trees by the waters would grow tall in their height.
No other trees would lift their tops among the clouds.
No other well-watered trees would stand as high as that tree.
God brought all these trees down.
He consigned them all to death.
He sent them to the depths of the earth.
They went among the people who go down to the Pit.
passages.original: לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ לֹא־ יִגְבְּה֨וּ בְקוֹמָתָ֜ם כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ מַ֗יִם וְלֹֽא־ יִתְּנ֤וּ אֶת־ צַמַּרְתָּם֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים וְלֹֽא־ יַעַמְד֧וּ אֵלֵיהֶ֛ם בְּגָבְהָ֖ם כָּל־ שֹׁ֣תֵי מָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ כֻלָּם֩ נִתְּנ֨וּ לַמָּ֜וֶת אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּת֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָ֖ם אֶל־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘On the day it was brought down to Sheol, I caused mourning. I covered the deep because of it; I held back its rivers; its abundant waters were restrained. I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field fainted because of it.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says these words.
On the day it was brought down to Sheol, I caused mourning.
I covered the deep because of it.
I held back its rivers.
Its abundant waters were restrained.
I made Lebanon mourn for it.
All the trees of the field fainted because of it.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה בְּי֨וֹם רִדְתּ֤וֹ שְׁא֙וֹלָה֙ הֶאֱבַ֜לְתִּי כִּסֵּ֤תִי עָלָיו֙ אֶת־ תְּה֔וֹם וָֽאֶמְנַע֙ נַהֲרוֹתֶ֔יהָ וַיִּכָּלְא֖וּ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וָאַקְדִּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְבָנ֔וֹן וְכָל־ עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה עָלָ֥יו עֻלְפֶּֽה׃

passages.text: I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall, when I cast it down to Sheol with those who descend to the Pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.
passages.sermon:
God spoke about Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
God said He brought Pharaoh down to Sheol.
Sheol is the place of the dead.
God made the nations tremble when Pharaoh fell.
The nations heard the sound of Pharaoh’s downfall.
God sent Pharaoh to Sheol with those who go down to the Pit.
All the trees of Eden were in the earth below.
These trees were the choicest and best of Lebanon.
These trees were well-watered.
All these trees found comfort in the earth below.
passages.original: מִקּ֤וֹל מַפַּלְתּוֹ֙ הִרְעַ֣שְׁתִּי גוֹיִ֔ם בְּהוֹרִדִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ שְׁא֖וֹלָה אֶת־ י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר וַיִּנָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ תַּחְתִּית֙ כָּל־ עֲצֵי־ עֵ֔דֶן מִבְחַ֥ר וְטוֹב־ לְבָנ֖וֹן כָּל־ שֹׁ֥תֵי מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: They too descended with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword. As its allies they had lived in its shade among the nations.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh had many allies among the nations.
Pharaoh and his allies went down to Sheol.
They joined those who were killed by the sword.
Pharaoh’s allies had lived under his protection among the nations.
passages.original: גַּם־ הֵ֗ם אִתּ֛וֹ יָרְד֥וּ שְׁא֖וֹלָה אֶל־ חַלְלֵי־ חָ֑רֶב וּזְרֹע֛וֹ יָשְׁב֥וּ בְצִלּ֖וֹ בְּת֥וֹךְ גּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: Who then is like you in glory and greatness among the trees of Eden? You also will be brought down to the depths of the earth to be with the trees of Eden. You will lie among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh was powerful and great.
Pharaoh was famous among the nations.
No one among the trees of Eden was like Pharaoh in glory and greatness.
But Pharaoh will be brought down to the depths of the earth.
Pharaoh will go down with the trees of Eden.
Pharaoh will lie among the uncircumcised.
Pharaoh will lie with those killed by the sword.
This is the fate of Pharaoh and all his multitude.
The Lord GOD has declared this.
passages.original: אֶל־ מִ֨י דָמִ֥יתָ כָּ֛כָה בְּכָב֥וֹד וּבְגֹ֖דֶל בַּעֲצֵי־ עֵ֑דֶן וְהוּרַדְתָּ֨ אֶת־ עֲצֵי־ עֵ֜דֶן אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֤ים תִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב ה֤וּא פַרְעֹה֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
